text: The Nominating Panel – Committee of Adjustment will conduct interviews and recommend two candidates to City Council for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment, one to the North York Panel and one to the Scarborough Panel.

The Nominating Panel – Committee of Adjustment: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment: Candidate COA2 - 175 Candidate COA2 - 209 Candidate COA2 - 232 Candidate COA2 - 252 Candidate COA2 - 291 Candidate COA2 - 239 Candidate COA2 - 285 Candidate COA2 - 216 Candidate COA2 - 90 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (November 3, 2021) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment.
